picks.title: SpaceX says it has agreement to acquire Cursor for $60B
picks.why_it_matters: A $60B acquisition of an AI coding startup signals massive validation for developer tools and could reshape how later-stage AI infrastructure companies get valued—creating both exit comps and competitive pressure for early-stage dev-tooling plays.

picks.title: AI research lab NeoCognition lands $40M seed to build agents that learn like humans
picks.why_it_matters: A $40M seed round for an AI agents startup from academic research shows continued investor appetite for frontier AI bets and sets a high bar for competing seed-stage deals in the autonomous agent space.

picks.title: Former Pinterest team redesigns email with Extra — and it's actually good
picks.why_it_matters: Strong founder pedigree from Pinterest tackling a massive, unsexy market like email is the kind of contrarian bet that can produce outlier returns if execution matches design DNA.
